prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (UV beds vs spray/airbrush), where in Charlotte you are, and whether you prioritize price, cleanliness, or a luxury experience. A few quick questions so I can give a targeted recommendation:
- Do you want a spray tan (no UV) or a UV tanning bed?
- Which neighborhood or ZIP code in Charlotte are you near?
- Any other priorities (budget, organic/vegan solutions, membership packages, quick walk-in)?

If you want an immediate general approach, here’s how to find the best salon for you and what to look for:

How to choose a good tanning salon
- Type: pick spray/airbrush for safer, sunless color; pick UV beds only if you understand risks. Many people prefer spray for natural results without UV exposure.
- Reviews: check Google and Yelp for recent reviews and photos. Look at 4–5 star comments and recurring complaints.
- Cleanliness & equipment: beds or booths should look well-maintained; spray studios should be clean and well-ventilated.
- Certifications & training: for spray tans, ask if techs are certified and what solution brands they use (quality solutions = more natural, longer-lasting results).
- Pricing & packages: chains often have membership deals for frequent tanners; single-session pricing varies a lot.
- Safety measures: beds should have timers, disposable eye protection, and staff should ask health questions. For spray, ask about patch tests if you have sensitive skin or allergies.

Common reputable national chains you can look for in Charlotte
- Palm Beach Tan
- Sun Tan City
- Sola Salons (booth rental franchise with spray/UV options)
- Planet Beach (spa/tanning hybrid)

Local & boutique tips
- Boutique spray-tan studios or salons often give the most natural results because techs are experienced and use higher-end DHA formulas. Search “airbrush spray tan Charlotte” + your neighborhood.

Quick safety/etiquette tips
- For spray tans: exfoliate and don’t use heavy lotions before the session; wear loose dark clothing after; follow aftercare (no shower for recommended wait time).
- For UV: limit frequency, follow staff guidance on session length, and wear protective eyewear.

If you tell me your neighborhood or ZIP code and whether you want spray or UV, I’ll list 3–5 top-rated salons near you and what each is best known for.
